question: Julius thinks of Subaru as a true friend, and they only look like they're getting along well from the outside, but despite that Subaru has never forgotten the humiliation that Julius put him through, and from the time that he was humiliated, even if he forgot, he's dislike Julius enough that he's shown no mercy and rejected Julius, would that be correct? Seen from Subaru's point of view, Julius lowered his value in the eyes of the girl that saved him, and was the ringleader behind their separation, so his favorability would be as terrible as Echidna's, so even if he respects him as a knight, it doesn't look like he'd think of him as a friend, and it wouldn't be odd if he held bad feelings towards him until the end...
answer: Neither Subaru nor Julius think of the other as a 'true friend', and I don't think they'll say anything like that in the future. What happened on the training ground is reason enough for Subaru do dislike Julius, but really, Subaru understands that what happened was his fault, and he understands why Julius did that, so he doesn't think anything in particular about it now.
